subject.title: fix(googlechat): fall back to text link when remote media upload fails with 403

question: Which Google Chat app-auth media fallback implementation should maintainers treat as canonical before merge?
rationale: The bug is real and current main still lacks the fallback, but this member-authored PR is dirty against current main and overlaps with two open same-root-cause PRs, so automation should not pick the branch direction alone.

options.title: Refresh This PR As Canonical
options.body: Resolve the conflicts, narrow the upload-403 predicate to scope-denial errors, preserve current action send metadata, and keep the three-path regression coverage before final review.

options.title: Choose A Sibling PR
options.body: Pause this branch if maintainers prefer another open implementation that can be refreshed cleanly and cover the action, adapter, and monitor paths.

options.title: Defer To OAuth Direction
options.body: Keep the fallback work paused only if maintainers decide the broader user-OAuth issue should own media delivery behavior instead of a link fallback.

recommendation.title: Refresh This PR As Canonical
recommendation.body: Resolve the conflicts, narrow the upload-403 predicate to scope-denial errors, preserve current action send metadata, and keep the three-path regression coverage before final review.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across the affected Google Chat API, action, and media delivery files.
